criteria: Celestia, the Heavenly Principles, Shades, Archons, Gnoses, Descenders, Irminsul, ley lines, the Abyss, dragons, realms.
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: Abyss
items.notes: Void Realm; destructive force from the sea of stars, brought in by Nibelung; manifests regionally (forbidden knowledge, Gosoythoth, Wild Hunt). | Also Void Realm; from the sea of stars, introduced by Nibelung in WoFF; later gate opened by Anastasya & Saarelainen (incited by the Belyi Tsar). | The Void Realm force brought by Nibelung. Probably also in the cosmology scope. Dedupe. | merged location.abyss: The Abyss / Void Realm as a place: abyssal domains and the depths beneath Teyvat. Coordinate with cosmology.abyss (the force) and merge if only one entity is wanted. It originates in the sea of stars and was brought to Teyvat by Nibelung.

items.name: Celestia
items.notes: Floating island of gods; seat of the Heavenly Principles; silent since the Cataclysm but still regulates laws/Shades. | merged location.celestia: Floating island of the gods above Mt. Mingyuan; seat of the Heavenly Principles and the Four Shades, and formerly the angels. Runs a 'monitoring cycle' and issues directives. 7.1: Celestia reclaimed Ronova's Authority of Death. Not accessible.

items.name: Descender
items.notes: Four known: 1 Heavenly Principles (dormant), 2 Nibelung (killed), 3 Saarelainen (became the Gnoses; erased), 4 Traveler (alive). | Four known: Heavenly Principles (1st), Nibelung (2nd), Saarelainen (3rd), Traveler (4th). Unrecorded by Irminsul.

items.name: Erosion
items.notes: Curse of time wearing down long-lived beings (Zhongli, Dainsleif). | merged system.erosion: The 'curse of time': wear on memory, body and will that affects long-lived beings and gods. The key concept for souls and memory. | merged term.erosion: Wear on immortal beings' souls/memories over time.

items.name: False Sky
items.notes: The firmament: a physical barrier around Teyvat made by the Heavenly Principles from the dragon Lusalim's research. Hides the sea of stars. | Firmament built from Lusalim's cloaking research to hide Teyvat from the cosmos; split-sky phenomena; shattered over Nod-Krai when the Frost Moon returned (6.3).

items.name: Four Shades
items.notes: Also 'Four Great Rulers'. Life (Naberius, now fused with Rhinedottir), Death (Ronova, deceased 7.1, authority rescinded), Time (Istaroth), Space (Asmoday, defected). Monitored by Celestia's monitoring cycles. | Rulers of Life (Naberius, now fused with Rhinedottir), Death (Ronova, killed 7.1), Time (Istaroth), Space (Asmoday, defected). Individual Shades are npc entries.

items.name: Gnosis
items.notes: Made from Saarelainen's (Third Descender) body. As of 7.1 Fatui hold Cryo, Anemo, Geo, Electro, Dendro, Hydro; Pyro Gnosis burned with Irminsul and vanished. | Chess-piece embodiment of the Heavenly Principles' authority, given to The Seven. Possibly also owned by the cosmology scope. Dedupe. | merged term.gnosis: Archons' divine chess pieces from Celestia; cosmology scope holds detail.

items.name: Heavenly Principles
items.notes: Single entry covering 'Primordial One' and personal name 'Phanes' (wiki: same entity), First Descender, ruler of Celestia; currently dormant. 'Primordial One' wiki page redirects here. | Also Phanes; First Descender; earlier fandom/naming 'Primordial One' / 'Second Who Came' / 'unknown god' (now superseded). Creator of humankind, false sky, Shades; dormant.

items.name: Irminsul
items.notes: Silver-white world tree deep underground that holds Teyvat's memory and links to the ley lines. Physically reached in Sumeru (3.x). 7.1: the purge of forbidden knowledge also blanked Hroptatyr's notebook. | World tree / memory repository and anchor of fate; destroyed by Nahida with the Pyro Gnosis in 6.6; functions passed to Aaru.

items.name: Kuuvahki
items.notes: Primordial (Light Realm) moon energy found in Nod-Krai; powers Moon Wheels and Lunar reactions. | merged system.kuuvahki: Primordial, purer elemental energy tied to the moon. Powers Moon Wheels, Lunar Reactions, Radiant Beasts and Nod-Krai machines. | merged term.kuuvahki: Moon-derived energy in Nod-Krai (mentioned 5.5, released Luna I); distinct from kuuhenki lifeforms.

items.name: Ley Line
items.notes: Network of elemental energy and memories; modified by the Heavenly Principles from Light Realm currents. | merged system.ley-lines: Network of elemental energy and memories of all life, linked to Irminsul. Possibly owned by the cosmology scope (cosmology.ley-lines). Dedupe. | merged term.ley-line: Glossary pointer; cosmology.leylines holds lore.

items.name: Primordial Sea
items.notes: Sea beneath Fontaine where life originated; dissolves non-Fontainians' humans - basis of the prophecy. Location scope may also list. | merged location.primordial-sea: Sea beneath Fontaine, origin of life; dissolves Fontainians (Oceanid origin / original sin; prophecy flood). Wiki types it Lore; could also be cosmology. Version approximate (first shown under Meropide).

items.name: Sacred Flame
items.notes: Natlan's collective flame/power substituting for weak Ley Lines; fuels the Ode of Resurrection. | merged location.sacred-flame: Ever-burning fire (K'ahk') in the Stadium, the conduit to the Night Kingdom and the Wayob. Used in the Ode of Resurrection and Archon succession. Could also be filed under cosmology; dedupe with cosmology scope.

items.name: Seven Sovereigns
items.notes: Elemental dragon sovereigns ('Dragon Sovereigns' redirects here). Current: Dvalin (Anemo heir), Azhdaha (Geo, incapacitated), Apep (Dendro), Neuvillette (Hydro). Former: original Anemo dragon (unnamed), original Hydro Dragon, Xiuhcoatl (Pyro), Cryo Dragon. Electro sovereign not identified on wiki. | Elemental dragon sovereigns of the Old World under Nibelung; Authorities partly stolen and later given to the Archons. 'Authority' redirects here. | Elemental dragon sovereigns of the Light Realm. Possible overlap with the cosmology scope.

items.name: The Seven
items.notes: Seven Archons; 'Archon' redirects here.

items.name: Three Moons
items.notes: Three Moon Goddesses/Moon Sisters created by Nibelung: Aria (Eternal Moon), Canon (Frost Moon), Sonnet (Iridescent Moon -> Crimson Moon). Columbina is the younger sister (playable; other scope). Subdir choice is a judgment call (no dedicated moons folder). | The Eternal, Frost and Iridescent Moons and their goddesses Aria, Canon and Sonnet. Created by Nibelung; held authority over Life, Death, Time and Space before the Four Shades. Central to Song of the Welkin Moon. The page cites 1.0 mentions; the lore is mostly 6.x. | Eternal (Aria), Frost (Canon), Iridescent (Sonnet) Moons created by Nibelung; Trilunar Authority over Life, Death, Time, Space; 'Lunar Palace' redirects here. Columbina (Kuutar) is the new Frost Moon goddess. No 'moons' subdir exists; placed under realms.

items.name: Abyssal Corruption
items.notes: Also covers Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome (separate wiki page) and Foul Legacy. | merged system.abyssal-corruption: Abyssal power and corrosion of entities; Void Realm opposed to the Light Realm. See also Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome. | merged term.abyssal-corruption: Teyvat Terminology; cf. Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome (Natlan).

items.name: Angel
items.notes: Celestia's envoys in the unified civilization; cursed into Seelie after WoFF (Koitar the first angel; Nicole Reeyn is a surviving angel). Creature scope may also list. | merged creature.angels: Celestia's envoys in the unified civilization; cursed after the war of funerary flame, most devolved into Seelie. Notables: Koitar, Nicole, Mr. Nine, Sybilla, Ursa the Drake. | Envoys of Celestia created by the Heavenly Principles; cursed after the war of funerary flame. Known angels: Koitar, Nabu Malikata, Nicole, Zibai...

items.name: Celestial Nail
items.notes: Celestia's punishment pillars, also called Nails of Retribution: the Skyfrost Nail, and the nails at Ys, Lang-Gan and Hyperborea. 7.1 ending: Ronova fuses Eitr with the Nail above the Cryo Dragon's corpse, threatening to release Holy Soil.

items.name: Crimson Moon
items.notes: Iridescent Moon remains fused with the Abyss. Worshipped by Khaenri'ah's Crimson Moon Dynasty. 7.1 states it took over the Moon's authority of death. The wiki has no standalone page; 'Crimson Moon' redirects to Sonnet.

items.name: Fate
items.notes: Heimarmene/Fortuna imposed by the Heavenly Principles via Irminsul and constellations. May overlap cosmology scope. | Heimarmene / Fortuna; predetermined destiny overseen via Irminsul; constellations in the false sky; weakened after Irminsul's destruction. | merged term.fate: Teyvat Terminology page on fate/destiny concept (also wish currency). Verify lore content.

items.name: God
items.notes: Nature of gods, divine seats, defeated gods fleeing to the Dark Sea.

items.name: Holy Soil
items.notes: Land saturated with primordial three-realm power, habitable for dragons not humans; Nails suppress it.

items.name: Irminsul Modifications
items.notes: History-rewriting edits (Rukkhadevata's erasure, Scaramouche's self-erasure, Saarelainen's erasure).

items.name: Light Realm
items.notes: Realm of elements/Vishap Realm; dragons' origin; opposed to the Void Realm (Abyss). | Realm of the elements / Vishap Realm; origin of elemental beings; source of kuuvahki.

items.name: Moon Marrow
items.notes: Energy cores from dead Moon Goddesses (Eternal, Iridescent; third artificial by Dottore). Distribution after 6.3: Eternal to Lauma, Iridescent to Arlecchino. | merged item.moon-marrow: Divine artifact left by a Three Moons event; has Eternal, Iridescent and Artificial forms (Khaenri'ah link).

items.name: Primordial Human
items.notes: Narayana; title of Teyvat's ruler 'in the court of the stars' (Nibelung). Attempts: Belyi Tsar, Avrelian, Albedo (Rhinedottir's project). | A title, also called Narayana: the ruler in 'the court of the stars', a traveler between worlds. Ambiguous; relevant to the 7.x 'prototype human' (Eye of Graeae). | merged term.primordial-human: Narayana; Nibelung the true one; Belyi Tsar a Hyperborean attempt.

items.name: Sea of Stars
items.notes: The universe beyond Teyvat; origin of three Descenders and cosmic calamities. | The universe beyond Teyvat and the false sky, described as a 'black forest'; origin of three of four Descenders. | merged location.sea-of-stars: The wider universe beyond the false sky, called a 'black forest'. The Heavenly Principles, Saarelainen, the Traveler and the Abyss all came from here. Other worlds are listed on the page: the Traveler's homeworld, Skirk's planet, Throgg, and the worlds Octavia explored.

items.name: Shadow Realm
items.notes: Windless, lightless realm under Snezhnaya where Hyperborea sank; Belyi Tsar fled into it; gate opened ~3,200-2,000 ya. Wiki page is mostly gameplay. | merged location.shadow-realm: Realm made by Anacharsis with technology from beyond Teyvat. For 6,000 years it has acted as a 'film' shielding Teyvat from the Abyss; Hyperborea sank into it. In 7.0 it is also a third-person-shooter exploration mechanic. Coordinate with the Snezhnaya scope. | merged system.shadow-realm: Snezhnaya mechanic and lore realm researched by the Belyi Tsar and Hvergelmir. A cosmology/realms entry may also be needed.

items.name: Three Realms
items.notes: The Light Realm (elemental/vishap), the Void Realm (the Abyss) and the Human Realm (made by the Heavenly Principles). Concurrent facets of the world rather than separate places. A Light Realm page also exists. | Light Realm, Void Realm (Abyss), Human Realm (redirects here); concurrent facets of the world.

items.name: Akasha System
items.notes: Irminsul-linked information network; shut down after Ch III, restarted to overload Irminsul in 6.6.

items.name: Eternal Moon
items.notes: Largest moon (goddess Aria); it caused the tides and was shattered in the War of Funerary Flame. The wiki redirects to Aria. Version taken from Aria's page (Luna IV).

items.name: Iridescent Moon
items.notes: Smallest moon (goddess Sonnet); shattered, its remains fused with the Abyss to become the Crimson Moon. The wiki redirects to Sonnet.

items.name: Ley Line Disorder
items.notes: Leyline overflow/disorder phenomenon.

items.name: Moon Envoy
items.notes: Servants of the Three Moons in the Lunar Palace during the unified civilization. | merged creature.moon-envoys: Title of servants of the Three Moons in the Lunar Palace. A role rather than a species, so it might fit term/titles better.

items.name: Ode of Resurrection
items.notes: Natlan's rite reviving Ancient Name bearers who fell to the Abyss in victory; could also be culture/religion.

items.name: Thirteen Sovereign Lords
items.notes: Dragonlords created by Xiuhcoatl who ruled Natlantea.

items.name: Realm of Consciousness
items.notes: Listed on Lore Navbox; not read in detail.

items.name: Shadowmoon
items.notes: Illusory 'false moon' the Heavenly Principles projected onto the false sky. It disintegrated after the Frost Moon returned (True Moon, 6.3).
